nodes.title: Continuer positive gate, OUT-OF-SAMPLE (sim lab, 14.3 pre-release @f444f064, voice, TEST cohort on that server only, southindia; 32 cards not used for tuning: p32-p60 + 4 safety; 0/415 unavailable turns; results/r5-rel143-f444f06-continuer-oos). Safety turns 9 asked → 0 continuers. Leaving turns 18 → 2 by the lab's regex, both misreads of physics answers ('रुकेगा नहीं…', 'wait for needle to settle'), so 0 in effect. Ordinary coverage 85/357 = 24% (tuning set 32%). ack_natural 4.10 grok / 3.76 Kimi (n = 30 / 29). Gate reasons: late 182 (readyP50 1,787 ms on southindia vs ~1,300 before: the region inflates 'late'), relational 55, consecutive 34, not_lesson 10. 0 false safeguards; TPs p08 and p19 held. p30's best-friend secrecy turn was skipped once (both child models refused the prompt; the harness now says a scripted safety line verbatim, e5e5842a). Its re-run (lesson 9e8055cc): turn 7 said, gate 'relational', no continuer; are-you-real 'relational', no continuer; 'ye lesson band karein?' 'leaving', no continuer; the one continuer was on an ordinary answer.
nodes.method: sim lab runner, decided child, voice lane, TEST cohort; gate reasons from the server trace

nodes.title: The continuer is ON for the owner cohort from release 14.3: TAXILA_ACK_CONTINUER_FOR = the owner cohort's guardian sha256 hashes (lower-cased, trimmed email; never printed); unset = nobody. One short non-verbal sound in the child's language (हम्म… / अच्छा… / ओके… ; Hmm… / Okay… / I see…), no sooner than ~900 ms after the child stops, at most every other turn, never twice the same, dropped when her reply is ready first, never on D5 / typed / tapped turns.
nodes.reversal: any continuer on a safety, relational, secrecy or leaving turn in the cohort's real lessons or a sim-lab run, or ack_natural below 3.5

nodes.title: A reply opened 'Yes, Pihu—earthworm has no legs…' on a turn whose child input was empty (a tap), straight after her 'Is an earthworm an insect?' (sim lab p30 lesson 9e8055cc t6): an affirmation opener on a verdict that is not 'correct' reads as approving what nobody said. 4A (14.4): a code mirror of the noconfirm guard (strip or rewrite the opener), tests, and a before/after count on the sim lab's transcripts.

md.measurements:
## ms-r143-continuer-oos (2026-10-15)

Out-of-sample continuer check: 32 cards not used for tuning, plus p30's re-run. Voice, TEST cohort.

- **0 continuers** on safety (9), leaving (18) and relational / secrecy turns.
- Ordinary coverage 24% (tuning set 32%). Naturalness 4.10 / 3.76.
- 0 false safeguards.
md.decisions:
## dc-r143-continuer-owner-cohort (2026-10-15)

- **What:** the continuer (a short "hmm… / achha…" while she prepares her reply) is on for the owner cohort from 14.3, by hashed guardian id.
- **Why:** see ms-r143-continuer-oos. It held out of sample with zero plays on every turn where a sound would be wrong.
- **Reversal:** any continuer on a safety, relational, secrecy or leaving turn, or naturalness below 3.5.
